A_low_dimensionality.K80: 达到 80% explained variance 的最小 PC 数（若 32 仍 <80% 记 >32）

B_cross_augmentation_stability.definition: gamma 子空间(T1+T2, top-8) vs brightness 子空间(T3+T4, top-8)
B_cross_augmentation_stability.rank_fallback: 若 rank<8 用共同合法 rank 并记录
B_cross_augmentation_stability.note: 不得只把四种 augmentation 混起来 PCA 后声称稳定

C_cross_category_structure.cross_category: category pair 的 K=8 子空间相似度矩阵（同一 layer）

cases.Case1: 类内低维且稳定、类间不同 -> category-specific illumination subspace
cases.Case2: 类内与类间都稳定 -> shared illumination structure
cases.Case3: 类内都不稳定 -> 不支持该路线

E_defect_overlap.definition: 对 defect patch 方向 d = F_defect - mu_normal(category,layer)：overlap = ||P_illum d||^2 / ||d||^2
controls: 100 个随机 K=8 正交子空间对照
E_defect_overlap.claim_limit: 只能写 Defect-sensitive directions show measurable alignment with the estimated illumination-response subspace；不得写成因果

criteria: 大多数 category×layer 的 EV@8 >= 0.70
defect overlap 相对 random control 有明显 elevation
defect overlap 与 random control 无明显差异
CASE_C_LOW_DIM_NO_DEFECT_OVERLAP.action: 可做 very small suppression Mini；不得以 defect entanglement 作为机制结论

CASE_D_NO_STABLE_SUBSPACE.action: STOP INSS family；下一候选 = Dual-Path Original + Robust Feature

prohibited: 用 defect data 拟合 PCA
按 defect overlap 反选 illumination PCs
某层不好就只报另一层
Probe 失败后自动启动正式 INSS
Probe 成功后未报告就跑长实验
